::: {lang="en"}
This website is written in **Icelandic**.

Machine translation into other languages will be offered here in the header through **WEB-T**, the European Commission's website translation tool, which uses the EU's eTranslation service. It is being set up.

Until then, your browser's built-in page translation can be used.

- [About WEB-T (European Commission)](https://website-translation.language-tools.ec.europa.eu/solutions/universal-plugin_en)
- [About eTranslation (European Commission)](https://commission.europa.eu/resources-partners/etranslation_en)
:::

---

Þessi vefur er skrifaður á **íslensku**. Vélþýðing á önnur tungumál verður í boði hér í hausnum í gegnum **WEB-T**, vefþýðingartól framkvæmdastjórnar Evrópusambandsins sem byggir á eTranslation. Uppsetningin er í vinnslu.
